Rank 24 - Agriculture

Dairy Milk and Cattle Health Ledger

Dairy farmers need milk yield, feed cost, breeding, vaccination, treatment, and buyer payment records.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 6,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month works if sold through cooperatives, collectors, or veterinary supply shops.

6.9Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 6,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target dairy farmers, milk collectors, and small chilling-center networks where daily milk volume and cattle health records matter.

Daily milk sale looks good but feed, treatment, and unpaid buyer dues reduce true profit.

Know which cow is profitable and which buyer owes money.

Validation signals

  • Livestock projects show organized dairy farmer groups.
  • Milk entry is daily habit.
  • Buyer dues are common.
  • Health reminders have practical value.

MVP modules

  • Cow profile
  • Daily milk entry
  • Feed cost
  • Treatment note
  • Breeding/vaccine reminder
  • Buyer payment
  • Monthly profit

Do not build first

  • Do not build cattle insurance first.
  • Do not provide veterinary diagnosis.
  • Do not require sensors.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Rural support.
  • Farmer literacy.
  • Low monthly willingness.
Mitigations
  • Group pricing.
  • Voice/number-first entry.
  • Agent-assisted setup.
